_comment: Entries install.ps1 adds to permissions.allow in ~/.claude/settings.json (it adds missing ones and never removes others; check_drift.py reports missing ones). Why: on 2026-11-22 the unattended weekly-brain-review run stopped at its first Bash call ('Tool permission stream closed before response received'), because nobody could answer the prompt. These rules cover only the commands that task needs: the vault health check and git inside the vault.
